changelog:
Groundwork for faster, more reliable channel starts, and a tidier Settings screen.

WHAT CHANGED

- The app now records how long each channel takes from your tap to the first picture, and the figure is in the log you can send with a problem report.
- The Pre-load highlighted channel switch is gone from Settings. It never did anything on a phone.
- Behind the scenes, the database and the player are now tested on an Android emulator every time they change, not just built.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- How channels play. The change that picks the right way to play a stream from what the provider actually sends is built, but it stays switched off until it has been tested on real streams on a phone.

NOT YET

- Channels whose provider sends a different format than the link suggests may still spin instead of playing.
